ellen_sales: Heads-up — Sentinel Bio (enterprise) asking for a 6-week POC of their sentinel-32b-utf8-slimq variant. Must-haves: p50 <160ms at 3k context, KV-prefix caching, SOC2 + FIPS KMS, EU residency. They prefer Dedicated but will consider Private for FIPS. Can SE/Infra/Security triage catalog fit + onboarding lift + ballpark POC cost?

ravi_se: On it. Two quick asks: exact tokenizer name and sample prompts/vocab. Also: is the variant slimq using a custom layout for KV embeddings?

ellen_sales: Tokenizer: "utf8-sentinel" (notes: strips bidi control chars and normalizes U+200E/U+200F differently). They uploaded 120 prompt examples and a small vocab diff. Variant notes: slimq uses compact int8 layout and custom KV packing.

ravi_se: Running verify locally:
```
redwood verify --model sentinel-32b --variant slimq --tokenizer utf8-sentinel --samples ./sentinel_samples.json
```
Prelim: tokenizer will need a tiny adapter to preserve RTL markers where they matter; KV packing uses nonstandard stride -> loader shim likely. Estimated SE effort: 4-8 hrs (adapter + shim + tests).

marta_infra: Perf note: With FIPS constraint hosted is out unless they accept BYO-HSM for Dedicated. For p50 <160ms @3k ctx: Dedicated with 3x A100/H100-equivalents + aggressive prefix caching should meet SLO at low concurrency. If they need multi-az failover add warm standby. Batching policy: max-batch=6, batch-slo=40ms.

marta_infra: Rough POC pricing for 6 weeks, ~250k tokens/day:
- Dedicated (eu-west, reserved + support): ~$11k with POC discount
- Private/on-prem: ~$29k one-time install + support (customer infra excluded)
Hosted (no-FIPS): ~$2k/mo but fails FIPS req.

oscar_security: FIPS KMS + SOC2 = blocker for fully-managed hosted. Two options: (A) Dedicated with customer-managed FIPS HSM in their VPC + audit forwarding, (B) Private with validated HSM. Need compliance contact, DPA/BAA if applicable, retention/delete SLAs, and SSO metadata. ETA: I'll draft scoping note in 48h.

ravi_se: Minimal adapter prototype (Rust) to normalize control chars and keep special marker token:
```rust
fn normalize(input: &str) -> String {
    // preserve <RTL_MARK> token, strip certain control chars
    let tmp = input.replace("<RTL_MARK>", "__RTL__");
    let tmp = tmp.chars().filter(|c| *c != '\u{202A}' && *c != '\u{202B}').collect::<String>();
    tmp.replace("__RTL__", "<RTL_MARK>")
}
```

marta_infra: Infra action items: (1) run micro-bench eu-west with slimq image + adapter/shim once PR lands (ETA 24h), (2) prepare Dedicated sizing + pricing note and network diagram for BYO-HSM (ETA 24h).

oscar_security: I'll list required evidence (FIPS cert/attestation, SOC2 excerpts, DPA items) and network constraints for HSM access. Also ask whether they need e-discovery/deletion proof.

bench-bot: micro-bench queued (job id: pb-55821). Results will post in-thread.

ellen_sales: Thanks — I'll confirm whether Dedicated with BYO-HSM is acceptable and will post the compliance contact + sample prompts here.
